[[No overall control]]{{efn|Labour minority.}} | after_election = | after_party = }} The '''2026 Rugby Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 14 of 42 members of [[Rugby Borough Council]] in [[Warwickshire]], [[England]].{{Cite web |last=mhclgpress |date=2026-02-16 |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections – MHCLG in the Media |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk |language=en}} ==Summary== ===Background=== In [[2024 Rugby Borough Council election|2024]], the council remained under [[no overall control]] but [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] overtook the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservatives]] as the largest party.{{Cite web |title=ELECTION RESULTS: Labour close gap on Tories at Rugby Borough Council |url=https://rugbyobserver.co.uk/news/labour-close-gap-on-tories-at-rugby-borough-council/ |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=Rugby Observer |language=en}}{{Cite news |title=Rugby result - Local postponed pending local government reorganisation.{{Cite web |date=2026-01-10 |title=Rugby Borough Council to ask for local election to be scrapped |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1dkr4vlwvro
